injury_predictions.name: RJ Harvey
injury_predictions.note: Short-term IR 10/31 (knee, hurt in practice 10/29). Must miss four games: Weeks 8, 9, 11, 12 (DEN bye Week 10). Eligible Week 13 vs MIA.
injury_predictions.source: AP via Washington Post/Fox Sports, NBC Sports (PFT), Yahoo (11/1)

injury_predictions.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_predictions.note: Right thumb injury on Baltimore's first offensive play of Week 8 vs BUF (first game back from the ankle). Minter: needs surgery and goes on IR, so he misses at least Weeks 9-12. Minter didn't know yet if it's season-ending; Week 13 is the earliest possible return.
injury_predictions.source: Jesse Minter via ESPN, Yahoo Sports, BaltimoreRavens.com (11/1)

injury_predictions.name: A.J. Brown
injury_predictions.note: Knee flare-up on top of the ankle; has missed the last two games. Listed Questionable for Week 10 and expected to travel to Munich, but the beat reporting says he likely will not play and is expected to be held out through the Week 11 bye, returning Week 12 at LAC. The 11/10 Sleeper move from Out to Questionable is a designation change only. Unconfirmed.
injury_predictions.source: ESPN (Schefter, knee is the primary concern); ProFootballRumors (11/2026); Musketfire (Vrabel: likely will not make it); NFL.com 2026 Patriots schedule (Week 11 bye)

injury_predictions.name: Jordyn Tyson
injury_predictions.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring. Reports 11/2 say he could debut Week 9 vs CLE (Nov 8) after the Saints bye. Unconfirmed until he's activated.
injury_predictions.source: Yahoo Sports / Heavy (11/2), Adam Schefter (ESPN) earlier

injury_predictions.name: Breece Hall
injury_predictions.note: Quad; missed five straight (through Week 8 vs LV). Rapoport (11/2): considered 'good to go', expected back Week 9 vs KC. Glenn: 'he's close', handling it carefully; workload may be limited with Braelon Allen involved.
injury_predictions.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network) via RotoWire; Aaron Glenn via NBC Sports (11/2)

injury_predictions.name: DeVonta Smith
injury_predictions.note: Hamstring setbacks: sidelined since Week 6, ruled out Weeks 7, 8 and 9. Not on NFL IR. Eagles bye is Week 10, so Week 11 is the earliest possible game; a report says not back until at least Week 11. Unconfirmed.
injury_predictions.source: The Fantasy Footballers (Week 9 'won't play Sunday'), FantasyPros, NBC Sports (PFT)

injury_predictions.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_predictions.note: Turf toe (plus thumb), out since Week 4; still Out for Week 9 (Sleeper status Out, 0 pts). Bears kept him off IR. Bears bye is Week 10, so Week 11 is the earliest possible game. Unconfirmed.

injury_predictions.name: David Montgomery
injury_predictions.note: Groin (hurt 10/11 at TEN). Hasn't practiced since; Ryans: week-to-week, ruled out Week 9 vs LAC after some progress. Not on NFL IR. Week 10 is the next game, unconfirmed. Woody Marks leads the backfield.
injury_predictions.source: DeMeco Ryans via The Fantasy Footballers, Newsweek, ClutchPoints

injury_predictions.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
injury_predictions.note: Knee tendon injury suffered in the Week 9 loss to GB; ruled out for Week 10 at DET and reported as a multi-week absence. Patriots bye is Week 11, so Week 12 at LAC is the earliest possible game. Sleeper has him Doubtful. Unconfirmed.
injury_predictions.source: NBC Sports Week 10 injury report (11/10); NESN (11/10); NFL.com/Patriots.com 2026 schedule (Week 11 bye)
